Seoul, Moon Agree on 15-Year Extension
<Seoul:team#403> fans celebrated as word of a signing became reality. <Bo-kyung Moon:player#45705> won't be pulling up stakes anytime soon, as he has signed a 15-year extension at a pay rate of $25,000,000 per annum.

Since he is widely seen as an integral part of the club, <Seoul:team#403> officials had to keep <Moon:player#45705> from jumping ship.
